sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Hemant Kumar Mishra,Abhishek Mishra,Arti Ganguly,Rashmi Singh,S Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pankaj Verma Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Supplementary Affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
None appears for the complainant.

The present bail application has been filed by accused-applicant seeking bail in Case Crime No.0119 of 2023, under Sections 498A/304B Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act,
Police Station Wazirganj, District Gonda.

sentences.text: It is alleged in the First Information Report, which was lodged by mother of the deceased, that her daughter Sayara was married with Salman, son of the applicant, with adequate dowry.
Out of the wedlock a child was born who is aged about two years.

In the night of 4.3.2023 at about 12.00 p.m.
the father-in-law of her daughter told the informant that her daughter has locked the room from inside and her child is crying.
In the morning she went to her daughter's place where she found that the door was locked from outside.
After the door was opened the informant found her daughter hanging.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that the applicant is the mother-in-law of the deceased.
She is innocent.
She has no previous criminal history.
General and sweeping allegations have been made in the First Information Report.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer, however, could not dispute the aforesaid facts.
Perused the record.
In the postmortem report, cause of death is asphyxia due to antemortem hanging.

The following antemortem injuries have been found on the body of the deceased:-
"1- ligature mark 28 x 2cm all around neck with gap of 05 cm right side upper neck just below right ear, 06 cm below chin and 05 cm below left ear.
On dissection under lying ligature mark subcutaneous tissue dry and which glistering partachament like tissue present.
2- contusion 6x 1 cm over mid chest 15 cm above umbilicus.
3- contusion 7 x 2 cm over left side back of chest 04 cm below lower end scapular 4- contusion 5x3 medial aspect of left leg 10 cm below knee. 5- contusion 7x1 cm posterior aspect of right arm."
Perusal of the statement of the complainant under Section 161 Cr.P.C. shows specific allegation of demand of dowry and cruelty committed upon the deceased.
Complicity of the applicant is prima facie evident.

On due consideration to the fact that the complicity of the applicant is evident; gravity of offence;
there is no explanation to the ante-mortem injuries on the body of the deceased by the learned counsel for the applicant; I do not find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
Let a copy of this order be transmitted to the trial court for expeditious disposal of the trial.
